start.speaker: sera
start.text: The common room. Everyone else asleep. I have carried people out of fire and I have never once been this afraid. If we do this, I do not do it halfway. I do not know how.

choices.text: I cannot give you that. Not now, maybe not ever.
Not tonight. Let me be sure before I say it.

stay.speaker: sera
stay.text: Then I am staying. The door stays shut tonight.

closed.speaker: sera
closed.text: Then I will hold the line and nothing else. Do not apologise. I asked.
